architecture: Live absolute-positioned HTML glyphs plus bounded regional graphics-only assets; no complete PDF-page screenshot is used.
decision: Approved after inspection of all 192 source/HTML comparison sheets at the canonical source-page aspect ratio.
authorized_exceptions: The repeating green/orange running header and footer decoration is removed on every page as requested.
InDesign filenames, timestamps, crop marks, and duplicate folio text are removed.
The printed folio remains visibly centered on every page and is excluded from ordinary narration.
The table of contents narrates page labels in the requested order, including Roman numerals.
A separate structured semantic layer supplies complete narration, image descriptions, responsive reading, and interactive exercise access.
